cross_table_patterns.example_question: What is the total cost of treatments for each dog?
cross_table_patterns.typical_structure: SELECT dogs.name, SUM(treatments.cost_of_treatment) FROM treatments JOIN dogs ON treatments.dog_id = dogs.dog_id GROUP BY dogs.name
key_considerations: Ensure to group by dog name to avoid duplicates.

cross_table_patterns.example_question: How many dogs does each owner have?
cross_table_patterns.typical_structure: SELECT owners.first_name, COUNT(dogs.dog_id) FROM dogs JOIN owners ON dogs.owner_id = owners.owner_id GROUP BY owners.first_name
key_considerations: Consider using GROUP BY to aggregate counts.
